### Full Job Description
Summary:
Software Engineer building Praetorian’s offensive-security platform. Shipping scalable Go, React, and AWS features that help prevent breaches.
Software Engineer building Praetorian’s offensive-security platform with Go, React, and AWS
Role description:
• Build and ship full-stack features for the Praetorian Guard platform
• Own work from design through production operations
• Overcome challenges in developing and operating the platform
• Write clear, tested, durable code
• Improve engineering standards through code reviews, technical proposals, and leading by example
• Translate real-world vulnerability findings into platform capabilities with offensive security engineers
• Design systems for attack surface management at scale
• Build queue-based security scanning pipelines, graph database systems, and real-time interfaces
• Ship major Guard platform features relied on daily by security teams
• Optimize graph queries and build AWS serverless infrastructure
• Integrate AI tooling into development workflows
• Turn high-level requests into practical customer-facing features
• Translate vulnerability patterns into automated detections
• Contribute through technical blog posts, internal knowledge sharing, or open-source work
• Mentor junior engineers and support continuous learning
Role requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or Physics
• 0–5 years of experience in cybersecurity, startups, or tech companies
• Idiomatic, testable, production-ready Go
• Understanding of serverless architectures, API design, and databases under real load
• Distributed systems, concurrency, failure modes, and data flow knowledge
• Ability to build responsive, performant, maintainable frontend UI with AI agents
• Side projects, open-source contributions, or technical writing
• Experience shipping something real outside a classroom
• Willingness and ability to use AI tools in development
• Experience or ability with AWS serverless architecture, CloudFormation, Lambda, React, and Playwright
• Ability to collaborate with offensive security engineers
• Ability to mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical knowledge sharing
Benefits:
• High-performance culture with deep ownership
• Work alongside top 1% industry talent
• Direct impact protecting the world's most critical organizations
Tech stack:
AWS, Cyber Security, Distributed Systems, React, Go
